definition_text: Information that is linked or reasonably linkable to an identified or identifiable individual
cross_references: Excludes de-identified data per § 6-1-1303(11); Excludes publicly available information; Excludes employee/B2B data in certain contexts

definition_text: Personal data revealing: racial or ethnic origin; religious beliefs; mental or physical health condition or diagnosis; sex life or sexual orientation; citizenship or citizenship status; genetic or biometric data processed for purpose of uniquely identifying individual; or personal data from known child
cross_references: Requires opt-in consent per § 6-1-1308(1); Subject to data minimization per § 6-1-1308(3); Subject to secondary use prohibition per § 6-1-1308(4)

definition_text: Exchange of personal data for monetary consideration OR OTHER VALUABLE CONSIDERATION by controller to third party
cross_references: Broader than VCDPA (includes non-monetary value like CCPA); Excludes certain disclosures to processors or for specific purposes; Subject to opt-out right per § 6-1-1306(1)(d)(II)

definition_text: Person that alone or jointly with others determines the purposes and means of processing personal data
cross_references: Must meet applicability thresholds per § 6-1-1304; Owes duties per § 6-1-1305 and § 6-1-1308

definition_text: Person that processes personal data on behalf of controller
cross_references: Bound by data processing agreement per § 6-1-1305(2); Must assist controller with consumer rights requests; Must assist with DPAs

definition_text: Individual who is a Colorado resident acting only in an individual or household context
cross_references: Excludes individuals acting in commercial or employment context; Has rights under § 6-1-1306

definition_text: Any operation or set of operations performed on personal data including: collection; use; storage; disclosure; analysis; deletion; modification; sharing
cross_references: Broad definition covers all data activities; Subject to controller duties

definition_text: Data that cannot reasonably be used to infer information about or otherwise be linked to an identified or identifiable individual or device
cross_references: Exempt from CPA if technical and organizational measures applied; Controller must commit to not re-identify; Cannot combine with other information to identify

definition_text: Person other than: consumer; controller; processor; or affiliate of controller or processor
cross_references: Recipients in data sales or sharing; Controller liable for third-party misuse

definition_text: Displaying advertisements to consumer based on personal data obtained from consumer's activity across non-affiliated websites applications or online services
cross_references: Subject to opt-out right per § 6-1-1306(1)(d)(I); Requires DPA per § 6-1-1309

definition_text: Automated processing of personal data to evaluate analyze or predict personal aspects concerning economic situation health preferences interests reliability behavior location or movements
cross_references: Subject to opt-out right if produces legal or similarly significant effects per § 6-1-1306(1)(d)(III); Requires DPA per § 6-1-1309

definition_text: Clear affirmative act signifying freely given specific informed and unambiguous agreement to process personal data
cross_references: Required for sensitive data per § 6-1-1308(1); Must meet Rule 7.03 standards; Cannot use dark patterns; Must be revocable

definition_text: Mechanism that communicates or signals consumer's choice to opt out of processing personal data for purposes of targeted advertising or sale
cross_references: Controllers must honor by 2024-07-01 per Rule 5.01; Examples: Global Privacy Control (GPC); Must be single request; No account required

definition_text: A person or entity authorized by the Consumer to act on the Consumer's behalf
cross_references: Referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1306(1)(a)(II); Subject to authentication under Rule 4.08

definition_text: The Processing of Personal Data that is automated through the use of computers computer programs or software or other digital technology
cross_references: Referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1303(20); Basis for Solely/Human Reviewed/Human Involved Automated Processing; Relevant to Profiling under Part 9

definition_text: Biometric Identifiers that are used or intended to be used singly or in combination with each other or with other Personal Data for identification purposes; does not include a photograph an audio/voice recording or data generated from them unless used for identification
cross_references: Referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1303(24)(b); Subclass of Sensitive Data; Excluded from Publicly Available Information

definition_text: Data generated by the technological processing measurement or analysis of an individual's biological physical or behavioral characteristics including fingerprint voiceprint eye retinas irises facial mapping facial geometry facial templates or other unique patterns
cross_references: Basis for Biometric Data definition

definition_text: A loyalty rewards premium feature discount or club card program established for the genuine purpose of providing discounts rewards or other actual value to Consumers that voluntarily participate
cross_references: Referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1308(1)(d); Governed by Rule 6.05

definition_text: An offer of superior price rate level quality or selection of goods or services provided to a Consumer through a Bona Fide Loyalty Program
cross_references: Related to Bona Fide Loyalty Program; Governed by Rule 6.05

definition_text: A Controller that knowingly collects and sells to Third Parties the Personal Data of a Consumer with whom the Controller does not have a direct relationship
cross_references: Subclass of Controller; Subject to Sale opt-out obligations

definition_text: The Consumer Personal Data rights granted in C.R.S. § 6-1-1306(1)
cross_references: Includes access correction deletion portability and opt-out; Exercised under Part 4

definition_text: Has the same meaning as set forth in C.R.S. § 24-85-102(2.3)
cross_references: Relevant to accessibility of disclosures under Rule 3.02

definition_text: Automated Processing of Personal Data where human involvement includes meaningful consideration of available data used in the Processing as well as the authority to change or influence the outcome
cross_references: Relevant to Profiling opt-out and DPA scope under Part 9

definition_text: Automated Processing of Personal Data where a human reviews the Processing but the review does not rise to the level of Human Involved Automated Processing
cross_references: Relevant to Profiling under Part 9

definition_text: Any visual depiction that depicts an identified or identifiable person's private parts or a person engaged in a private act in circumstances in which a reasonable person would reasonably expect privacy
cross_references: Nonconsensual Intimate Images excluded from Publicly Available Information

definition_text: The categories of data Processing from which the Consumer may opt out pursuant to C.R.S. § 6-1-1306(1)(a)
cross_references: Covers Targeted Advertising Sale and Profiling; Exercised via UOOM

definition_text: As referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1303(17) does not include data obtained in violation of C.R.S. §§ 18-7-107 or 18-7-801; inferences from multiple independent sources; Biometric Data; Genetic Information; publicly available information combined with non-public Personal Data; or Nonconsensual Intimate Images
cross_references: Refines statutory Publicly Available Information exclusion

definition_text: As referred to in C.R.S. § 6-1-1303(24)(a) includes Sensitive Data Inferences (e.g. geolocation showing a visit to a mosque used to indicate religious beliefs is Sensitive Data)
cross_references: Expands scope of Sensitive Data; Related to Sensitive Data Inference

definition_text: Inferences made by a Controller based on Personal Data alone or in combination with other data which indicate an individual's racial or ethnic origin; religious beliefs; mental or physical health condition or diagnosis; sex life or sexual orientation; or citizenship or citizenship status
cross_references: Treated as Sensitive Data; Governed by Rule 6.10

definition_text: Automated Processing of Personal Data with no human review oversight involvement or intervention
cross_references: Relevant to Profiling opt-out and Consent under Part 9

definition_text: Mechanisms that clearly communicate a Consumer's affirmative freely given and unambiguous choice to opt out of Processing for Targeted Advertising or the Sale of Personal Data pursuant to C.R.S. § 6-1-1306(1)(a)(I)(A) or (1)(a)(I)(B) meeting the technical specifications under C.R.S. § 6-1-1313(2)
cross_references: Governed by Part 5; Related to statutory DEF-UOOM node
